name: Talisapatradi Vatakam

sections.introduction: Talisapatradi Vatakam is known as one of the effective ayurvedic formulation that has mixture of good herbs. This formulation is known to treat the problems related to respiratory and digestive systems.
sections.ingredients:
Talisapatra – Abies webbiana 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Chavika – Piper chaba 
 Anantamoola – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Dry Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Usheera – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Chaturjata – Known to have combination of following herbs: 


 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) 
 Patra (Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Nagakeshara (Mesua ferrea) 

 Method of Preparation 

 Took the herbs in its given quantity. 
 Took 1 to 3 herbs up to 48 grams, 4 and 5 up to 96 grams, shunthi up to 144 grams, 7 and 8 ingredients up to 12 grams. 
 Powder all the ingredients and mix with three times of jaggery. 
 Make pills from this paste. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Talisapatradi Vatakam aids in pacifying diseases related to Vata and Kapha. It acts as an extremely useful Ayurvedic formulation in managing digestive disorders as it is helpful to control vomiting, sprue, provides relief in abdominal pain, effective in controlling gastritis and bloating. It efficaciously manages all types of cough and controls occurrence of asthma and promotes easy breathing and is beneficial in controlling other respiratory ailments like bronchitis, it reduces the inflammation in the bronchial tract and improves the process of breathing. It helps in regulating the body temperature as a result controlling fever, and has potent anti-inflammatory property that reduces inflammation. It possesses the property to improve the hemoglobin level which helps to overcome anemia. In Bloating, It reduces the abdominal distention. In case of ascites, reduces inflammation in fistula. Along with this, it also helps in igniting the digestive fire which controls the digestive problems. It manages the Malabsorption syndrome which as a result improves the nutrient absorption.
sections.indications:
Bloating 
 Gastritis 
 Sprue 
 Abdominal disease 
 Vomiting 
 Inflammation 
 Anemia 
 Cough 
 Piles 
 Fever 
 Asthma
sections.dose: Two to three tablets four times a day, before or after meals with milk or warm water.
sections.contraindications:
Take under medical prescription. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
